# Gov.cn: China's newly installed wind, solar power capacity up 22% in 2025

Published: 12 Feb 2026. Xinhua.

## Key Findings
- 2025 new solar + wind capacity: **>430 million kW (430 GW)**, up **22% YoY** — record high.
- Cumulative wind + solar: **1.84 billion kW (1,840 GW)** = **47.3% of total installed capacity**.
- Wind + solar **surpassed thermal power for the first time**.
- Solar + wind = **22% of total electricity output** in 2025.
- NEA chief engineer Liu Deshun: 2026 will promote new energy storage industry.
- By 2035: new power system capable of accommodating high share of new energy (per NDRC guideline, Nov 2025).
